text:
𝗪𝗜𝗗𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗘𝗡! 🇿🇦🇦🇺

Cape Town decider: SA 140/4 in the 2nd innings, just 40 ahead of Australia's 429.

Inglis 102 and the 185-run stand with Carey set it up. Lyon bowled Bavuma late 🔥

#Cricket #SAvAUS

facebook.caption:
𝗖𝗔𝗣𝗘 𝗧𝗢𝗪𝗡 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝗞𝗔 𝗙𝗔𝗜𝗦𝗟𝗔 𝗥𝗨𝗞𝗔 𝗛𝗔𝗜! 🔥

👉 Day 3 ke end pe South Africa 329 & 140/4
👉 Australia ka first innings 429 tha, SA sirf 40 run aage
👉 Inglis ka 102 aur Carey ke saath 185 run ki partnership
👉 Lyon ne Bavuma ko din ke aakhri minutes mein bowled kiya

Kaun jeetega series decider? Comment karo 👇
